title: Claims and proof governance
current_state: Public user, outcome, logo, testimonial, ATS and automation claims exist; substantiation was not supplied.
problem: Prospects cannot distinguish measured evidence from marketing promise.
recommendation: Create a claim ledger and remove or qualify every unsupported or contradictory material claim.
expected_user_impact: Clearer expectations and lower risk of misleading product use.
expected_business_impact: Lower legal, refund and reputation risk; stronger proof discipline.
risks: Short-term conversion may fall after unsupported claims are removed
success_metrics: 100% of material public claims have a source, method, owner and review date
founder_question: What proof standard and removal authority should apply to public claims?
notes: No claim is treated as verified until the substantiation pack is reviewed.

title: Activation and outcome instrumentation
current_state: No event dictionary, funnel, cohort or outcome export was supplied.
problem: The team cannot tell whether a user reaches value or improves application outcomes.
recommendation: Instrument the path from verified profile and live job to reviewed packet, submission, response and interview.
target_user: Founder, product team and active job seekers
expected_user_impact: Faster removal of friction in the first-value journey.
expected_business_impact: Reliable prioritisation, retention analysis and experiment decisions.
risks: A weak taxonomy could create false certainty
Sensitive content could leak into analytics
success_metrics: Reproducible activation and outcome cohort report
founder_question: What exact activation event and customer outcome should HireNudge optimise?
notes: The working outcome candidate is qualified interview responses per 10 high-fit, human-reviewed applications.

title: Candidate evidence profile
current_state: Resume and preferences are collected; a canonical evidence model is unverified.
problem: Career facts are re-entered, become inconsistent or are invented across modules.
recommendation: Create a candidate-owned record of facts, evidence, source, sensitivity and confirmation state for the chosen workflow.
expected_user_impact: Less repetition and better control over personal claims.
expected_business_impact: Reusable personalisation and lower hallucination risk.
risks: Large platform build before the initial workflow is validated
success_metrics: Zero unconfirmed facts in sampled outputs
founder_question: What minimum evidence-profile scope is required for the first application workflow?
notes: This is not a universal career-data platform in V1.

title: Job-centered journey architecture
current_state: The observed dashboard and navigation are module-first; synchronized journey work is being discussed.
problem: Users must translate a feature menu into a coherent job-search plan.
recommendation: Prototype a stage-aware home and a job-centered navigation model with one primary next action.
expected_user_impact: Lower cognitive load and faster path to first value.
expected_business_impact: Higher activation with less redesign waste.
risks: Aesthetic preferences could override task evidence
success_metrics: Task completion for one real application
Median time to saved reviewed packet
founder_question: Should the product architecture be job-centered rather than module-centered?
notes: Validate before a full visual redesign.

title: Application packet core object
current_state: Jobs, documents, outreach, tracking and interview tools appear as separate modules.
problem: Users cannot see one job's evidence, materials, actions and outcome in one place.
recommendation: Define an application packet that links job, alignment, artifacts, notes, outreach, submission and outcome.
target_user: Users preparing and tracking real applications
expected_user_impact: One coherent workspace for each application.
expected_business_impact: Stronger activation, repeat use and outcome learning.
data_dependencies: Job, artifact, action and outcome records
risks: Domain migration could disrupt existing modules
success_metrics: Share of submitted applications linked to a packet
founder_question: Should the application packet become HireNudge's core product object?
notes: This is the proposed connective tissue, not an approved replatforming.

title: Explainable profile-to-role alignment
current_state: Numeric match scores are visible; methodology and explanation quality are unverified.
problem: A score hides requirements, evidence, gaps, unknowns and uncertainty.
recommendation: Lead with a requirement evidence map and label the result as alignment, never hiring probability.
expected_user_impact: Better role selection and clearer improvement actions.
expected_business_impact: Trust differentiation and higher-quality job saves.
risks: Users may still read a score as probability
founder_question: Will HireNudge ban hiring-probability language and approve profile-to-role alignment as the label?
notes: Any aggregate score should remain secondary until validated.

title: Job-source rights and partnership strategy
current_state: Potential ATS, aggregator and scraping sources were researched; current contracts and production sources are unknown.
problem: Technically accessible job data may not be licensed for commercial redistribution or automated application.
recommendation: Adopt a source policy based on curated ATS boards, direct partnerships and a licensed aggregator pilot; exclude restricted scraping as the core.
expected_user_impact: More trustworthy job inventory and clear attribution.
expected_business_impact: Lower takedown and platform risk; clearer coverage economics.
legal_dependencies: Commercial-use, attribution, retention and takedown review
risks: Coverage may shrink after rights controls
success_metrics: 100% discoverable jobs have a documented rights class
founder_question: What coverage trade-off is acceptable for a rights-aware source policy?
notes: Blocked on current source inventory, contracts and legal review.

title: Job provenance, freshness and lifecycle quality
current_state: Freshness labels are visible; expiry, duplicate and verification behavior are unknown.
problem: Stale, duplicate, mislabeled or fraudulent jobs waste time and damage trust.
recommendation: Persist source, posted, fetched, verified, expiry, removal, duplicate and sponsorship-evidence fields and audit a 500-job sample.
expected_user_impact: Fewer dead, duplicate and misleading roles.
expected_business_impact: Higher retention and better provider-cost control.
founder_question: What freshness and coverage threshold is required before jobs are promoted?
notes: Thresholds require a 500-job baseline.

title: Base and job-specific version lineage
current_state: An editor is visible; multi-version lineage and rollback are unverified.
problem: Users lose track of which resume or letter was used for each job.
recommendation: Link immutable exports and submissions to a base profile, job, packet and outcome with diff and restore.
expected_user_impact: Recoverability and confidence in submitted materials.
expected_business_impact: Repeated use and packet-level outcome learning.
founder_question: What artifacts become immutable at export or submission?
notes: Depends on HN-003 and HN-004B domain choices.

title: Truth-preserving AI edits
current_state: Achievement quantification is discussed; provenance and confirmation controls are unverified.
problem: AI can strengthen prose by inventing metrics, credentials or company facts.
recommendation: Require source-backed edits, ask for missing evidence and block unconfirmed numbers or credentials.
target_user: Resume, cover-letter, outreach and interview users
expected_user_impact: Stronger materials without fabricated claims.
expected_business_impact: A defensible trust position and lower user harm.
success_metrics: Zero inserted metrics without confirmation in sampled outputs
founder_question: Will HireNudge require confirmation for every new factual claim?
notes: This rule should apply across every generative surface.

title: Job-linked material variants
current_state: Resume, cover-letter and outreach generators are visible; deeper controls are discussed.
problem: Generic drafts offer little value and can be unsafe to send unchanged.
recommendation: Provide recipient, purpose, tone, length, source panel, variations, edit diff and explicit review within the application packet.
expected_user_impact: Faster relevant drafts with visible control.
expected_business_impact: Higher feature value without autonomous-action risk.
data_dependencies: Verified job, company and recipient facts
founder_question: Which artifact and recipient types belong in the first packet workflow?
notes: Explicitly excludes autonomous sending.

title: Public sensitive-data incident remediation
current_state: The supplied public portfolio reference exposed identity-document numbers on the research date.
problem: Public identifiers can create immediate identity and privacy harm.
recommendation: Remove the identifiers, purge caches where possible, scan all public outputs and record the incident response.
target_user: The exposed individual and future portfolio users
expected_user_impact: Reduced immediate exposure and safer publishing precedent.
expected_business_impact: Lower critical privacy and reputation risk.
risks: Cached or indexed copies may remain
Other pages may contain similar data
success_metrics: Identifiers removed from live and controlled cached surfaces
founder_question: Who has immediate authority to remove exposed sensitive data and close the incident?
notes: This remediation is separate from any future portfolio feature.

title: Privacy-safe portfolio publishing
current_state: Portfolio visual quality is discussed; demand and production controls are unverified.
problem: Relevant users need credible sharing with explicit control over public fields.
recommendation: After role-family validation, test original templates with private defaults, public preview, identifier blocking, opt-in indexing and one-click unpublish.
expected_user_impact: Safer personal-brand publishing.
expected_business_impact: Selective acquisition and sharing surface.
risks: Sensitive data may evade pattern checks
founder_question: Does the initial role family need a portfolio at all?
notes: Do not begin feature work until HN-010A is closed.

title: Application tracker and outcome loop
current_state: A tracker and empty state are visible; packet and outcome linkage are unverified.
problem: Users cannot see the next action or learn which job, source, material and follow-up led to progress.
recommendation: Build the minimum manual tracker for stage, packet, source, follow-up and outcome; keep inbox access optional.
expected_user_impact: Clear next steps and a persistent record of the search.
expected_business_impact: Critical repeat use and an outcome dataset.
risks: Board complexity could delay the minimum loop
founder_question: What minimum stages and denominator define the outcome loop?
notes: P0 covers the minimum loop, not an elaborate board or inbox sync.

title: Send-only Gmail integration
current_state: A Gmail connection gate is visible; requested scopes, token controls and verification status are unknown.
problem: Users need convenient sending without granting mailbox reading or losing review control.
recommendation: Use `gmail.send` at send time, review every message, cap sends, and revoke plus delete tokens on disconnect.
target_user: Users who choose to send outreach
expected_user_impact: Lower permission burden and fewer accidental sends.
expected_business_impact: Lower OAuth, security and suspension exposure.
success_metrics: Token revocation and deletion tests pass
founder_question: Will the initial boundary be send-only with no inbox read or autonomous follow-up?
notes: Blocked on current-scope inspection and security/legal confirmation.

title: Governed contact-enrichment pilot
current_state: Apollo, Hunter and alternatives are discussed; no provider contract or lawful-use review was supplied.
problem: Relevant recipient discovery can require sourced personal data with substantial rights and spam risk.
recommendation: Test one provider, one country and one recipient use case only after contract, DPA, source, notice, suppression and lawful-basis review.
expected_user_impact: Fewer irrelevant recipient guesses and clearer source context.
expected_business_impact: Reply-quality evidence with bounded provider exposure.
founder_question: Which single country, provider and recipient use case is eligible for legal review?
notes: Provider compliance does not create HireNudge's lawful basis.

title: Transcript-first job and round interview practice
current_state: Interview-question surfaces are visible; job-specific transcript coaching is discussed.
problem: Generic questions do not improve a candidate's answer for a specific role and round.
recommendation: Start with text or editable transcripts, a disclosed rubric, evidence-linked feedback and retry by interview round.
expected_user_impact: Specific, actionable answer practice.
expected_business_impact: Premium value close to the target outcome.
legal_dependencies: AI feedback disclosure and accessibility review
founder_question: Which role families and interview rounds enter the transcript MVP?
notes: Do not reduce readiness to one global score.

title: Opt-in realtime voice practice
current_state: Voice practice is discussed and technically feasible; no HireNudge implementation or evaluation was supplied.
problem: Some candidates want realistic conversation practice and descriptive delivery feedback.
recommendation: Add voice only after transcript value is proven; keep text parity, visible recording, editable transcript and default raw-audio deletion.
confidence: High on sequencing; Medium on demand
expected_user_impact: More realistic practice without compulsory voice use.
expected_business_impact: Potential premium usage with higher cost and trust burden.
legal_dependencies: Audio privacy, processor, retention and accessibility review
success_metrics: Transcription error by accent and device
founder_question: Will HireNudge prohibit personality, emotion, accent, honesty, confidence and employability scores?
notes: Voice is not required for the first interview-prep release.

title: Event-triggered lifecycle and preference center
current_state: Personalised lifecycle communication is discussed; event quality, consent and deliverability are unverified.
problem: Users miss next actions or receive noisy, generic communication.
recommendation: Use workflow triggers, category preferences, global frequency caps, quiet mode and clear suppression.
target_user: Active, paused and inactive job seekers
expected_user_impact: Timely reminders with user-controlled frequency.
expected_business_impact: Higher repeat use and lower notification fatigue.
founder_question: Which channels, categories and global frequency cap should apply first?
notes: Do not launch advanced personalisation before event correctness is measured.

title: India-tested search-sprint pricing
current_state: USD plus GST credit plans are public; willingness to pay, COGS and entitlement behavior were not supplied.
problem: Users cannot easily relate credits and foreign-currency pricing to a short job-search episode.
recommendation: Test INR tax-inclusive episodic plans and transparent action metering after pricing interviews and a unit-cost model.
expected_user_impact: Clearer purchase, renewal and usage expectations.
expected_business_impact: Willingness-to-pay and contribution-margin evidence.
legal_dependencies: GST, refund, renewal and display-currency review
founder_question: Which durations, price cells and meter enter the first paid test?
notes: Do not set INR prices from competitor currency conversion.

title: First 100 paid-customer learning program
current_state: A prior first-50 plan and a later first-100 proposal exist; no cohort results were supplied.
problem: The team lacks paid behavior, workflow and willingness-to-pay evidence.
recommendation: Use the first 10 eligible users in cohort 1 as calibration, then complete four sequential cohorts of 25 for 100 unique paying users.
confidence: High that evidence is needed; Medium on cohort design
expected_user_impact: High-touch help and a clearer product workflow.
expected_business_impact: Validates wedge, WTP, service burden and repeat use before scale.
legal_dependencies: Participant consent, compensation and outcome-data review
success_metrics: 100 unique paying participants including the eligible calibration users
founder_question: Should the target be 50 or 100 paying customers, and what capacity exists for the offer?
notes: Calibration users count toward cohort 1 when they meet the same eligibility and paid-customer definition. Planning allocations are not forecasts.

title: Initial ICP and role-family validation
current_state: India-first employed switchers are a repository hypothesis, not a founder-approved ICP.
problem: Targeting all personas and corridors dilutes product decisions and acquisition learning.
recommendation: Test English-speaking India-based employed switchers with 30–60 day intent, then select one or two role families from internal evidence.
expected_user_impact: More relevant jobs, constraints and guidance.
expected_business_impact: Focused positioning and distribution learning.
data_dependencies: Current user, job and channel mix
risks: A narrow but wrong wedge may exclude a stronger segment
success_metrics: Activation, D7 repeat use and WTP by segment
founder_question: Which provisional ICP, exclusions and role families should guide the first 90 days?
notes: Strategic urgency does not make this a P0 product requirement.

title: One India-to-country mobility pilot
current_state: Several corridors are discussed; destination, coverage and sponsorship data are not selected.
problem: International applicants need verified authorization and sponsorship context, not broad global listings.
recommendation: After the domestic core, validate one destination and role family with sourced sponsorship evidence and explicit uncertainty.
expected_user_impact: Safer selection of roles that may fit authorization needs.
expected_business_impact: A possible TerraTern-aligned differentiation test.
success_metrics: Application and interview outcomes with caveats
founder_question: Which one destination and role family, if any, should enter a mobility pilot?
notes: Foreign-to-foreign and all-corridor coverage remain out of scope.

title: Accessible founder and product design system
current_state: A modern light redesign is discussed; the existing founder workspace has a separate dense design system.
problem: Inconsistent hierarchy, states and accessibility increase task friction and rework.
recommendation: Define shared tokens, primitives, semantic labels, WCAG 2.2 AA criteria, reduced motion and explicit system states after flow validation.
target_user: All product users and founder-dashboard viewers
expected_user_impact: Clearer, more accessible and more predictable interaction.
expected_business_impact: Less rework and stronger activation support.
risks: Cosmetic work could displace activation work
success_metrics: WCAG AA automated and manual checks
Baseline and threshold to be set
founder_question: Which design principles are approved before visual exploration begins?
notes: Competitor visual expression is not a source to copy.

title: Organic founder and product learning engine
current_state: Competitor ads are being collected and content workflows are being explored; performance evidence is absent.
problem: Generic AI content does not build trust or reveal which customer problems resonate.
recommendation: Publish original evidence-based teardowns, product demos, India hiring realities and trust decisions with one learning goal per piece.
expected_user_impact: Useful proof and education before signup.
expected_business_impact: Message learning and qualified organic acquisition.
data_dependencies: Qualified signup and activation by content
legal_dependencies: IP, endorsement, likeness and claim review
success_metrics: Baseline and threshold to be set
founder_question: Which founder voice, primary channel and proof threshold should guide the first 30 days?
notes: Use competitor work for principles, not scripts, layouts, characters or artwork.

title: Paid acquisition readiness and creative tests
current_state: AI-assisted ads and competitor-inspired research are discussed; activation, attribution and margin gates are absent.
problem: Paid traffic would amplify an unmeasured funnel and produce uninterpretable CAC.
recommendation: Run small original creative tests only after activation, D7 repeat use, claim and contribution-margin gates pass.
target_user: Qualified prospects in the selected ICP
expected_user_impact: More relevant ads aligned to actual product value.
expected_business_impact: Controlled CAC learning without premature scale.
legal_dependencies: Claims, targeting, creator disclosure and platform-policy review
risks: Optimising CTR instead of customer outcome
founder_question: What exact gates and spending ceiling unlock paid acquisition?
notes: Ad archive volume is not evidence of competitor performance.

title: Support, feedback and release operating loop
current_state: No support corpus, feature-request log, bug taxonomy, release process or decision cadence was supplied.
problem: Failures, objections and customer needs do not reliably change priorities.
recommendation: Centralize tagged support, research, bugs, requests, releases and experiment decisions with a weekly review.
expected_user_impact: Faster issue resolution and clearer release communication.
expected_business_impact: Better prioritisation and retention evidence.
success_metrics: Share of decisions linked to evidence
Baseline and threshold to be set
founder_question: Who owns weekly evidence, support and experiment review?
notes: Owner recommendations are functions, not assignments.

title: Value-triggered referral loop
current_state: No referral behavior or verified value trigger was observed.
problem: Activated users may lack a safe, timely way to invite a peer.
recommendation: Test referrals only after a verified packet or practice value event; never expose application data.
expected_user_impact: A low-friction way to help a peer.
expected_business_impact: Potential lower-CAC acquisition with quality signal.
risks: Incentives may attract low-quality or fraudulent signups
success_metrics: Baseline and threshold to be set
founder_question: Which verified value moment should trigger a referral ask?
notes: No reward should be approved before baseline behavior is known.

title: University and placement-cell pilot
current_state: Institutional distribution is a strategy hypothesis; buyer evidence is absent.
problem: Institutions may need measurable application readiness, but the product is not validated for cohort delivery.
recommendation: Conduct buyer research and consider one paid pilot only after D2C activation and outcome instrumentation work.
expected_user_impact: Structured application-readiness support.
expected_business_impact: Later B2B revenue and distribution evidence.
legal_dependencies: Student consent, institutional terms and no-placement-guarantee review
success_metrics: Baseline and threshold to be set
founder_question: What D2C evidence must exist before institutional buyer research advances to a pilot?
notes: Do not promise placement outcomes.

title: Reject autonomous high-volume applications and outreach
current_state: Public `autopilot` and `bulk` language exists; exact product behavior is unknown.
problem: Unreviewed volume can create poor applications, spam, user account harm and platform sanctions.
recommendation: Prohibit fully autonomous apply and outreach sequences; require human review and quality caps for external actions.
expected_user_impact: Fewer harmful, irrelevant or accidental external actions.
expected_business_impact: Protected brand, deliverability and platform access.
effort: S to prohibit; larger to enforce
success_metrics: Complaint and suspension rates within predefined stop limits
founder_question: Will the founder explicitly reject fully autonomous and high-volume external actions?
notes: A Not Recommended initiative can still require a P0 decision and enforcement.

title: TerraTern and HireNudge consent boundary
current_state: TerraTern is a potential distribution and mobility advantage; data-sharing behavior and controller roles were not supplied.
problem: A user who shared data for one brand or purpose may not have consented to use by the other.
recommendation: Separate purposes, access and data; require explicit, purpose-specific opt-in with no pre-checked consent.
expected_user_impact: Clear agency over cross-brand data use.
expected_business_impact: A sustainable distribution relationship with lower privacy risk.
data_dependencies: Current data flows and lead sources
founder_question: What are the controller roles, allowed cross-use purposes and required opt-in?
notes: Blocked on the current data map and counsel.

title: User privacy controls
current_state: A general privacy policy exists; in-product export, deletion, retention and integration revocation were not verified.
problem: Users cannot easily inspect or control sensitive career, email, audio and mobility data.
recommendation: Implement visible export, item and account deletion, retention choices, permission inventory and integration revocation.
expected_user_impact: Practical control over personal data and integrations.
expected_business_impact: Lower privacy risk and stronger trust at conversion.
success_metrics: Export, deletion and revocation tests pass
Zero orphaned integrations in sampled audits
founder_question: What data rights and deletion SLA will HireNudge commit to in product?
notes: The current email-request route is not evidence of complete implementation.

title: Security and incident-response baseline
current_state: Production controls, RBAC, audit logs, key handling, extension review and incident response were not supplied.
problem: Resume, OAuth, contact, audio and immigration data create a large breach impact.
recommendation: Complete a system inventory and verify least privilege, encryption, secret rotation, audit logs, deletion, extension permissions and incident response before risky integrations scale.
target_user: All users and the operating team
expected_user_impact: Lower likelihood and impact of account or data compromise.
expected_business_impact: Launch readiness and lower security exposure.
success_metrics: No critical extension or OAuth finding remains open
founder_question: Who owns security, what launch gate applies, and what audit depth is funded?
notes: Blocked on architecture and control evidence.

title: AI, model and subprocessor transparency
current_state: The privacy policy contains general AI caveats; provider, model, retention and feature-level limitations are not inventoried.
problem: Users and the team cannot see where sensitive data goes or what AI output can and cannot support.
recommendation: Maintain a current provider and subprocessor register, model-purpose map, retention matrix and feature-level AI limitations.
target_user: Trust-conscious users, legal, security and product
expected_user_impact: Informed use of AI features and data sharing.
expected_business_impact: Better procurement, privacy and unit-economics decisions.
risks: Stated controls may not match systems
success_metrics: 100% production AI features mapped to provider, purpose and retention
founder_question: What transparency level and review cadence should HireNudge publish?
notes: A trust page should reflect tested controls, not substitute for them.

title: One decision-grade free tool
current_state: SEO and free tools are discussed; demand and conversion evidence are absent.
problem: Search prospects need useful value before signup, while thin programmatic pages create little trust.
recommendation: After activation works, test one utility such as a source-aware job checker, notice-period planner or alignment explainer.
expected_user_impact: Immediate help with a real search decision.
expected_business_impact: Qualified organic demand and a product-led proof surface.
legal_dependencies: Claims, job-data and privacy review by tool
success_metrics: Baseline and threshold to be set
founder_question: Which single utility serves the chosen ICP and can be kept accurate?
notes: No programmatic SEO scale before product conversion is understood.

title: Mascot and motion-led landing experiment
current_state: A professional mascot and maze or pinball journey are discussed.
problem: The brand may need warmth and memorability, but novelty can obscure the proposition.
recommendation: After message and flow validation, compare a lightweight linear journey with a restrained original motion concept and full reduced-motion parity.
confidence: High on sequencing; Low on conversion value
expected_user_impact: Potentially clearer and more memorable product story.
expected_business_impact: Brand differentiation if it preserves comprehension and performance.
risks: Novelty hurts clarity, LCP, keyboard access or brand originality
success_metrics: Baseline and threshold to be set
founder_question: Should mascot and motion work wait until activation and positioning are validated?
notes: Do not copy Jobright's Orion or another competitor's distinctive expression.

title: Internal evidence and customer-research intake
current_state: The repository contains a detailed intake request; no completed internal evidence pack was supplied.
problem: Public research cannot establish live capability, product-market fit, priorities or feasibility.
recommendation: Collect de-identified analytics, entitlements, support, interviews, roadmap, architecture, provider, cost and founder-objective evidence before roadmap approval.
expected_user_impact: Fewer roadmap decisions based on public inference.
expected_business_impact: Higher-quality sequencing and lower wasted effort.
success_metrics: All critical intake sections completed or explicitly unavailable
No raw customer content in strategy dashboard
founder_question: Who owns each internal evidence export and what can be supplied within 10 business days?
notes: This is the main blocker to evidence-backed roadmap approval.

title: Search-status mode
current_state: Search stage appears in product concepts; a user-controlled active, interviewing, paused, offer or ended state is not verified.
problem: The product may treat a paused or successful user as churn and continue irrelevant nudges.
recommendation: Let users set and update search status; use it to change the home, reminders, retention analysis and subscription prompts.
target_user: Active, interviewing, paused and completed searchers
expected_user_impact: More relevant product state and fewer unwanted messages.
expected_business_impact: Cleaner retention interpretation and better win-back timing.
risks: Stale status if the user is not prompted appropriately
success_metrics: Retention segmented by true search state
founder_question: Which search states should change product and lifecycle behavior?
notes: User-confirmed status is preferable to inference from inactivity.
